_about: What ESRS counts as a biodiversity-sensitive area, and which loaded protected-area layers (protected_dataset_loads.dataset) are one of the listed kinds. A layer not listed is never counted; a listed kind with no loaded layer is named as not assessed. 'Near' has no measure in either text, so the platform reports only sites located inside a listed area; whether a site is near one is the undertaking's statement.

2023.quote: Natura 2000 network of protected areas , UNESCO World Heritage sites and Key Biodiversity Areas (‘KBAs’), as well as other protected areas , as referred to in Appendix D of Annex II to Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2139
2023.ref: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772, Annex II (glossary), 'Biodiversity sensitive area'
kinds: other protected areas (Appendix D of Annex II to 2021/2139)

2026.quote: Biodiversity-sensitive areas are: (a) areas protected through legal or other effective means, including Natura 2000, UNESCO Natural World Heritage Sites, Ramsar sites , and other protected areas , for instance defined by national legislation sources; and (b) areas included under Key Biodiversity Areas (KBAs) , Ecologically or Biologically Significant Marine Areas, IUCN Red List of Ecosystems or habitats of species listed in the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species
kinds: Ecologically or Biologically Significant Marine Areas
habitats of IUCN Red List species

osm.why: a volunteered map, not one of the kinds either definition lists
